title: 3 of 5 Pro agents lack the per-agent model assertion their siblings have
evidence:
Sibling Pro agents DO assert the constructed object's model:
tests/unit/test_agents_consistency_checker.py:29:        assert agent.model.model == "gemini-3.6-flash"
tests/unit/test_agents_risk_scorer.py:39:        assert agent.model.model == "gemini-3.6-flash"

The 3 agents touched by this diff use get_agent_llm but have NO such assertion (rg "model" in their test files returns only comment lines / nothing):
tenant_scorer/agents/verification_compliance_judge.py:216:        model=get_agent_llm("verification_compliance_judge"),
tenant_scorer/agents/final_compliance_reviewer.py:234:        model=get_agent_llm("final_compliance_reviewer"),
tenant_scorer/agents/personal_statement_analyzer.py:309:        model=get_agent_llm("personal_statement_analyzer"),

Their resolution is covered only at the function level:
tests/unit/test_config.py:66-73:
    def test_all_agents_default_to_gemini_flash(self, monkeypatch):
        """With no env vars, every agent returns the hardcoded default."""
        for agent in AGENTS:
            env_var = f"{agent.upper()}_MODEL"
            monkeypatch.delenv(env_var, raising=False)
        monkeypatch.delenv("DEFAULT_MODEL", raising=False)
        for agent in AGENTS:
            assert get_agent_model(agent) == "gemini-3.6-flash"
detail: Diff moves 5 Pro agents to flash. consistency_checker and risk_scorer unit tests assert agent.model.model == 'gemini-3.6-flash'; the other 3 omit it, so an agent-wiring regression there is caught only by the function-level test, not the constructed object.
recommended_fix: Add a test_model() asserting agent.model.model == 'gemini-3.6-flash' to the verification_compliance_judge, final_compliance_reviewer and personal_statement_analyzer unit tests, matching their 2 siblings.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: Config-value-only diff (Terraform/env/README + a config.py comment). Runtime resolution is fully covered: test_config.py asserts all 12 agents resolve to gemini-3.6-flash, the fallback chain, and the dedup/tag-suffix. P0 n/a; P1 resolution 100%; overall >=80%.
recommended_fix: None required to pass. Optional defence-in-depth: add the 3 missing per-agent model assertions noted above. Terraform/env values themselves rely on terraform tooling, not pytest (by design).
